Messages.Author: alex fnurp
Messages.Body:
A vampire goes on an action to equip with a Vial of Elder Vitae, can
she then burn it to get fortitude and play freak drive at the end of
this action if it succeeds?

Messages.Author: alex fnurp
Messages.Body:
On 25 Nov, 07:35, alex fnurp <a.gyhles...@gmail.com> wrote:
> A vampire goes on an action to equip with a Vial of Elder Vitae, can
> she then burn it to get fortitude and play freak drive at the end of
> this action if it succeeds?

Forgot to tack on relevant cardtexts:

Vial of Elder Vitae
Type: Equipment
Cost: 1 pool
Equipment.
The vampire with this equipment may burn this card to gain 1 level of
any one Discipline until your next untap phase. The vampire cannot
choose a Discipline he or she already has at the superior level.

Freak Drive
Type: Action Modifier
Requires: Fortitude
Cost: 1 blood
[for] Only usable at the end of a successful action (after resolving
the action). This vampire untaps.
[FOR] As above, but usable even if the action is blocked (play after
combat, if any).
